name: Magic Patterns
tagline: AI prototyping for product teams — generate UI in your own design system.
description: An AI design tool that turns prompts into working UI prototypes product teams can test with users and hand to engineering. Version 2.0 imports components from Figma, Storybook, or any website via its Chrome extension, so generated screens match your real design system rather than generic mockups. Includes real-time collaboration and a free tier to start.
edge: Generates prototypes inside your own design system — imported from Figma, Storybook, or any site — instead of generic AI mockups.
pros: Prototypes you can test and hand off
